name: Dual Ingestion GitHub Repo Import Workflow
description: Verifies switching between ZIP upload and GitHub repository ingestion tabs with repository input validation.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the ShipSafe security cockpit at the root page
Click the 'Import GitHub Repo' tab button on the ingestion dropzone
Verify that the repository URL input field and Quick Try presets are rendered
Verify that the 'Import & Scan Repo' button is present
Verify that the file dropzone returns to the drag-and-drop ZIP archive mode
